# External comparison baseline

Install the official [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype/tree/8c32a9dc5d72c033816c6a8110b37f40cf94fba4) at commit `8c32a9dc5d72c033816c6a8110b37f40cf94fba4` into `third_party/dsh-superagent-prototype/`, as described in the [reproduction guide](../docs/reproducibility.md).

Keep its original MIT license (DeepSeek Harness Team). This downloaded checkout is ignored by ClonAct Git and excluded from its Python package. It is distinct from the included Worker bridge in `dsh_runner/synaptic_worker_plugin/`.
